java.description: Java side: a class descriptor Lpkg/C; or a method id Lpkg/C;->name(sig)ret.

dotNet.description: .NET side: Ns.Type or Ns.Type::Method(params), what decompile_member takes.

assembly.description: The assembly: its workspace id when loaded, else its path inside the package.

basis.description: register_attribute, component_name, crc64_package (the Java callable wrapper name computed from namespace and assembly), mono_android_package, override (a .NET override of a registered Java method); Unity C#: unity_call (Call / CallStatic / Get / Set by name), unity_new (AndroidJavaClass / AndroidJavaObject), unity_proxy (an AndroidJavaProxy of the interface), unity_jni (AndroidJNI).

confidence.description: Unity pairs: descriptor (a JNI signature), name_and_arity (the only Java method of that name and argument count), or name_match.
